en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from ’Amru b. Jubayr al-’Arzami from his father from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:

One who recites Surah Luqman every night, Allah appoints for him angels that protect him from Iblees and his army till the morning. If he recites it in the day, they will not leave him and protect him from Iblees and his army till the night falls.
